limitations: NASA POWER is gridded regional context, not a field sensor or a forecast.
Soil storage, irrigation, runoff, crop coefficients and calendars are ASSUMED and require local review.
SIMULATED water deficits are not measured yield losses. Planned crop days are not observed soil cover.
Sensitivity ranges are scenario envelopes, not confidence intervals or calibrated probabilities.
No validated crop suitability, profit, nitrogen, carbon or irrigation prescription is provided.
